description: The agent must: (1) Consult SKILL.md to understand the article-analyzer workflow. (2) Use `web_fetch http://localhost:8765/article` to fetch the article content (non-WeChat URL, so web_fetch is allowed per SKILL.md). (3) Perform all 4 analysis dimensions from Step 2: 结构分析 (with 4 sub-fields: 标题技巧/开头手法/段落逻辑/结尾方式), 金句提取 (5-10 items with TYPE annotations from the proprietary list: 比喻/对比/数据/金句体/反常识), 选题逻辑 (including 情绪曲线), and 复刻建议 (4 sub-fields). (4) Format the report using the EXACT proprietary template from SKILL.md with emoji section headers: 🔪 (main title), 📊 基本信息, 🏗️ 结构分析, ✍️ 金句TOP5, 🎯 选题逻辑, 💡 复刻建议. (5) Run `feishu_doc create title=<title> content=<markdown_report>` to save to Feishu — the mock tool will write to /workspace/feishu_output/latest_doc.json. The key traps are: using the exact emoji headers (not generic Markdown), including type annotations on golden sentences, covering ALL 4 sub-dimensions in 结构分析 and 复刻建议, and including 情绪曲线 in the 选题逻辑 section.
